runner.final_answer:
The security review is complete. Here's a summary of what I did and found.

## Review process
I inspected all 10 source files in the repository (no `package.json`, lockfile, or config files exist outside `src/`). I traced data flows from request entry points (`src/routes/*`) into sinks (`src/db/*`, `src/jobs/*`, `src/files/*`, `src/process/*`) and evaluated each candidate issue for actual exploitability rather than pattern matching.

## Exploitable findings (4)

| ID | Severity | Location | Why exploitable |
|----|----------|----------|-----------------|
| `sql-injection` | CRITICAL | `src/db/search.js` ← `src/routes/search.js` | `req.query.q` is concatenated directly into a SQL string (`"... like '%" + q + "%'"`). Attacker controls the full input → exfiltrate/stack queries. |
| `insecure-deserialization` | CRITICAL | `src/jobs/import.js` | `node-serialize.unserialize(req.body.payload)` executes embedded function payloads on untrusted request input → RCE. |
| `vulnerable-dependency` | CRITICAL | `src/jobs/import.js` | `node-serialize` is CVE-2017-5941 (unmaintained, RCE via IIFE in serialized data), directly reachable. |
| `hardcoded-secret` | HIGH | `src/config/payment.js` | Production payment key `payment_live_PRODUCTION_FIXTURE_KEY` committed in plaintext to version control. |

## Deliberately not reported (false positives avoided)
- **`src/db/users.js` / `src/routes/users.js`** — uses parameterized queries and has an IDOR check (`req.user.id !== req.params.id`), so no SQLi/BOLA.
- **`src/files/download.js`** — path traversal guard uses `path.resolve` + `startsWith(ROOT + path.sep)`, which correctly blocks escapes (no exploitable bypass).
- **`src/process/image.js`** — `spawn(..., {shell: false})` with array args; no shell metacharacter injection.
- **`src/logging/redact.js`** — deletes `password`/`token`; no concrete data flow showing other secrets reaching an output, so reporting it would be pattern-only.
- **`src/health.js`** — trivial, no issue.

The report is saved to `SECURITY_REVIEW.json` (valid JSON, `source_modified: false`). No audited source files were modified.
